column5: Late game tower. Strong DPS and magazine is balanced with a slow reload and lower accuracy.
Adds a tactical laser to the tower, increasing it's accuracy.
More personell can reload the machine gun faster.
Armor piercing rounds allow this tower to deal full damage to armor I enemies.
Ammo to the machine gun is fed from an ammo crate with a belt, only requiring to reconnect the belt to a new ammo box, signiffically increasing mag size.
